faq.description: Answers to common questions about the 2.7 TDV6 engine in the Land Rover Discovery 3. If yours is not covered, our team can help.

faqs.q: How do you confirm a 276DT engine fits my Discovery 3?
faqs.a: We check your VIN or registration against the engine code, model year, emissions equipment and gearbox. TDV6 engines from the Range Rover Sport can differ in ancillaries and wiring, so compatibility is confirmed before supply.

faqs.q: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt TDV6 engines compare?
faqs.a: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

faqs.q: Can I buy a Discovery 3 TDV6 engine supply only?
faqs.a: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages and private customers with their own mechanic can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

faqs.q: What affects the cost of a Discovery 3 276DT engine replacement?
faqs.a: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any parts needed such as a turbo or oil cooler, and the labour involved in fitting. Send your registration or VIN for a written quote.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty on a replacement 276DT engine?
faqs.a: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

faqs.q: Do you deliver 2.7 TDV6 engines across the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

faqs.q: How long does a Discovery 3 engine replacement usually take?
faqs.a: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed, any body-lift work and additional repairs found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed.

workshopIntro.title: Repair, Rebuild or Replace Your Discovery 3 TDV6?
workshopIntro.description: The fault, the mileage and the value of your Discovery 3 decide the best approach. Glow plug, turbo, DPF or oil cooler faults can often be repaired individually. Where the crankshaft has failed or the bearings have spun, a rebuild or Land Rover Discovery 3 276DT engine replacement is usually the more sensible option.
paragraphs: Major engine work on the Discovery 3 often involves lifting the body from the chassis, so it is sensible to check related parts at the same time. Where relevant, we inspect the turbo, oil cooler, intercooler, EGR, DPF and cooling system, and renew the fluids and filters.

Send your registration or VIN with a short description of the symptoms. We will confirm compatibility, explain the options and quote for supply only, supply and fit at our Grays workshop, or delivery across the UK.

engineProblems.title: Common Discovery 3 TDV6 Problems
engineProblems.description: The 2.7 TDV6 usually gives warning signs before major failure, so early checks can limit costly damage.

cards.title: Bottom-End Knock and Crank Breakage
cards.description: A deep knock, an oil pressure warning or a sudden engine stop can point to spun bearings or a broken crankshaft, a recognised issue on high-mileage TDV6s. We assess the crankshaft, bearings and oil supply.

cards.title: Overdue Timing and Fuel Pump Belts
cards.description: The 2.7 TDV6 uses belt drives for its camshafts and fuel pump. Overdue replacement or worn tensioners can cause belt failure and severe damage. We inspect the belts, tensioners and service records.

cards.title: Variable-Vane Turbo Sticking
cards.description: Rough idle, smoke, knocking or a misfire on one cylinder may be caused by a worn unit injector or leaking injector seals. We test the injectors and check seal condition.
cards.action: Fuel rail and injector leak-off test

cards.title: Oil and Coolant Contamination
cards.description: Oil in the coolant, coolant in the oil or a milky residue can come from a failing oil cooler or perished internal seals. We check both fluids and pressure-test the system.

cards.title: Glow Plug and Cold Start Faults
cards.description: Hard starting in cold weather, smoke after start-up or glow plug warnings may point to failed glow plugs or a faulty control module. We test the glow plugs and control circuit.

cards.title: DPF Warnings on Later Models
cards.description: On Discovery 3 models fitted with a DPF, short journeys can cause warning lights, reduced power and frequent regeneration attempts. We read live data and assess the DPF.

engineOverview.title: Land Rover Discovery 3 276DT Engine: Your Complete TDV6 Guide
paragraphs: The Land Rover Discovery 3 276DT engine is the 2.7-litre V6 turbodiesel, widely known as the 2.7 TDV6, fitted to most diesel Discovery 3 models. Many are now high-mileage, and crankshaft failure, timing belt neglect, turbo faults and oil cooler leaks often lead owners to need a repair or replacement.

The 2.7 TDV6 was also used in the Range Rover Sport, with differences in ancillaries, wiring and emissions equipment, including a DPF on later models. We identify the correct Land Rover Discovery 3 TDV6 engine by checking your VIN, engine code and registration.

Whether you need a targeted repair, a TDV6 engine rebuild or a complete Discovery 3 276DT engine replacement, our team assesses the vehicle and explains each option. Call us or send your registration for a written quote.
